📢 [Hybrid] Paid Internship Opportunity!

The ASEAN Centre for Energy (ACE) is seeking talented individuals to join the team as:
1, Energy Efficiency & Conservation (EE&C) Intern
2. Promoting Energy Efficiency in Buildings in ASEAN (PEEB ASEAN) Intern

📅Application deadline: 10 November 2026

🔗 aseanenergy.org/opportunities
